# MKS’ Atotech to highlight innovations for advanced packaging at SEMICON Europa 2026


**Berlin, November 2, 2026** — MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, today announced that its strategic brand Atotech, which offers process chemicals, equipment, software, and services, will participate in SEMICON Europa 2026, taking place November 10-13, 2026, at Messe München in Munich, Germany.


At booth C1-201, the company will showcase technologies designed to address key challenges in advanced packaging, semiconductor interconnects, and sustainable manufacturing.


As semiconductor innovation continues to accelerate, advanced packaging has become a critical enabler for applications ranging from artificial intelligence and high-performance computing to automotive and industrial electronics. At the same time, manufacturers face increasing pressure to improve performance and reliability while reducing costs, optimizing resource utilization, and advancing sustainability goals. These priorities are particularly relevant to the European semiconductor ecosystem, where demand continues to grow for reliable, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing solutions.


At SEMICON Europa, Atotech, an MKS brand, will present process technologies that support reliable redistribution layer (RDL) formation, advanced metallization, and next-generation packaging applications. The solutions are designed to help customers meet increasing demands for interconnect density, package performance, and long-term reliability while maintaining cost-effective manufacturing operations.


Among the technologies featured at the booth are **Spherolyte® Sn 3 E** , a sustainable and cost-efficient pure tin-plating process, **Xenolyte® Pd LP** , a low-palladium-content process that helps reduce precious metal consumption, and **Everplate® Cu 300 FG** , an advanced copper electroplating process that enables direct Cu-to-Cu bonding at low temperatures for next-generation semiconductor packaging.


Designed to support hybrid bonding applications, Everplate Cu 300 FG helps address increasing demand for higher interconnect density, improved performance, and reliable manufacturing of advanced packaging architectures. Together, these innovations respond to growing industry demands for improved process efficiency, reduced dependence on high-cost raw materials, and more sustainable manufacturing practices while maintaining the performance and reliability required for advanced electronic applications.


Visitors interested in emerging hybrid bonding approaches can also learn more about MKS’ Atotech’s latest technical white paper, “Hybrid Copper Bonding for Advanced Packaging – From Technology Fundamentals to the Everplate® Cu 300 Fine-Grain Electroplating Process.” The publication examines the role of copper microstructure in Cu-to-Cu bonding and discusses process approaches that support next-generation heterogeneous integration and fine-pitch packaging architectures.


In addition to its booth activities, MKS’ Atotech will contribute to the technical conference program. Christian Wendeln, R&D Manager SC ECD, will present *“Advancing Copper Metallization for Reliable RDL Scaling in Next-Generation Packaging.”* The presentation will explore how copper plating chemistry, deposit quality, and microstructure influence RDL performance and reliability as the industry moves toward larger package formats and panel-level manufacturing.


Throughout the event, MKS’ Atotech experts will be available to discuss emerging technology trends, manufacturing challenges, and innovations that support the next generation of semiconductor devices.
